resources.string: A reusable Jetpack Compose component that searches GitHub users and repositories as you type, merging both into one alphabetically-sorted list.
Open the Component or Overlay tab below to try it live.

The suggestion panel above floats over whatever content sits below it — it never owns the backdrop, scrim, or navigation. Dropped inside a Box aligned over a real screen, the panel would overlay that screen’s content instead of pushing it down like it does here.
Unrelated host content — the suggestion panel overlays this feed instead of pushing it down.

string-array.name: demo_requirements
string-array.item: Search starts only once the query is at least 3 characters long
Searches both GitHub users and repositories
Merges both result types into a single, alphabetically-sorted list
Caps the combined result list at 50 items
Shows loading, empty, and error states
Handles rapid typing gracefully — debounced, cancels stale requests
Works as a reusable component, not hardcoded to one screen
